Teams in the sdvplotR index

Source: R/resolve.R
sdv_teams.Rd

One row per team: its canonical team_id (the key every helper resolves to), names, abbreviation, conference and colours. The R counterpart of sdvplot's teams().

Usage

sdv_teams(league = NULL, include_conferences = FALSE)

Arguments

league

A league key from sdv_leagues(), or NULL for every league.

include_conferences

Also list the conference and league rows (the college conferences, and the AFC, NFC and NFL). Their program is "conference" or "league" and their team_id is the short name ("SEC", "AFC"). The logo helpers draw them by that key; colour helpers and sdv_resolve() never answer one.

Value

A data frame:

col_nametypedescription
leaguecharacterLeague key
team_idcharacterCanonical team id (the ESPN id where ESPN has the team)
abbrcharacterAbbreviation (NA where the league has none)
namecharacterFull name
short_namecharacterShort display name
locationcharacterCity or school
programcharacterNA for a team; "conference" or "league" for those rows
conference_idcharacterThe team's conference row team_id
conferencecharacterConference name
color_primarycharacterPrimary colour (hex)
color_secondarycharacterSecondary colour (hex)
color_sourcecharacter"nflverse", "espn", "logo", "cbbplotR" or "fallback"

Examples

sdv_teams("nfl")
